content.title: Action-Triggered Comic Graphics | Character Lock and Poster Finish
content.summary: An adult courier turns three movements into a map-poster lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One character identity anchors every graphic chapter. + A visible action precedes each graphic response. + Typography remains short, exact and unobscured. + Detail shots reconnect to the complete body. + The final poster reunites character, palette and title.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one original adult animated courier with a silver bob, amber visor, cobalt jacket and white boots on a coral paper field. A controlled knee-drop triggers the exact impact word "CLACK" while a navy checkerboard opens beneath both boots. Return her to a full-body pose inside one cobalt poster panel beneath the exact title "NIGHT ROUTE".
required_anchors: One character identity anchors every graphic chapter.
A visible action precedes each graphic response.
Detail shots reconnect to the complete body.
The final poster reunites character, palette and title.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult courier turns three movements into a map-poster lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: An adult courier turns three movements into a map-poster lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One character identity anchors every graphic chapter.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One character identity anchors every graphic chapter."

invariants.rule: A visible action precedes each graphic response.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "A visible action precedes each graphic response."

invariants.rule: Typography remains short, exact and unobscured.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Typography remains short, exact and unobscured."

invariants.rule: Detail shots reconnect to the complete body.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Detail shots reconnect to the complete body."

invariants.rule: The final poster reunites character, palette and title.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final poster reunites character, palette and title."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
